issues.description: The problem statement's UML and tasks specify numberOfTutors as type int, but the solution implementation declares the numberOfTutors attribute and constructor/setter parameter as short. This creates a cross-artifact type mismatch: students reading the UML expect int but the reference code uses short, which can cause confusion when implementing constructor/signature types and when matching tests that expect int-based signatures.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the numberOfTutors type across all artifacts. Change the solution (and any example/template signatures) to use int for the numberOfTutors field and its constructor/setter parameter to match the UML and problem description. Alternatively, update the UML and problem text to specify short if that was intentional, but prefer using int for consistency and to avoid unnecessary confusion.
